5.  Recommendation that the City Council provide direction on a potential update to the business
  license tax structure and related changes to Chapter 5.06 of the City of Hawaiian Gardens
  Municipal Code.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Provide direction to staff on the preferred business license tax model and
  direct staff to return on July 22, 2026, with the necessary documents to place the ballot measure
  before the voters.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, presented the staff report.

  Eric Myers, HdL, continued the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember De Paula, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to
  approve Model 1, as amended, the Single Gross Receipts and Contractor Flat Rate ­ applies a
  single gross receipts structure to all businesses, consisting of a $50 flat rate for businesses with up
  to $30,000 in gross receipts, followed by a rate per $1,000 of gross receipts above $30,000.
  Under this model, businesses classified as contractors, without a business location in the City,
  would be charged a flat rate of $175. Applying a rate of $0.95 per thousand of gross receipts over
  the base of $30,000; and direct staff to return on July 22, 2026, with the necessary documents to
  place the ballot measure before the voters.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; De Paula, Farfan, Vargas, Roa
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Del Rio
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0
